content.short: Harvard Blockchain is a student club that aims to increase blockchain adoption.
content.description: Harvard Blockchain is a student-led, community-driven initiative that promotes education, awareness, and adoption of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies at Harvard. Through a program of events, talks, workshops, and collaborative projects, Harvard students explore the latest advances in blockchain and their practical applications across a range of industries. Members also connect with other blockchain communities to share knowledge and work together on developing blockchain-based solutions.
